description: The SEO goldmine view: queries ranking just off page one (average position 8-25) with enough impressions to be worth optimizing. These are the keywords where a small content tweak can win real clicks. Computed client-side from search analytics; returns queries sorted by impressions.

end_date.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (lag ~2-3 days behind today).

limit.description: Max queries to return, ranked by impressions (default 25).

min_impressions.description: Only include queries with at least this many impressions (default 10).

position_max.description: Upper bound of the striking-distance band (default 25).

position_min.description: Lower bound of the striking-distance band (default 8).

site_url.description: The Search Console property. Use the exact form shown by gsc_list_sites: a Domain property is 'sc-domain:example.com'; a URL-prefix property is the full origin with a trailing slash, e.g. 'https://example.com/'.

start_date.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 28 days before end_date if omitted in your call).

name: gsc_striking_distance
title: Striking-distance keywords
